summary: iter49 — All 5 follow-up refinements from iter48 are VERIFIED GREEN on web preview. (1) Header-slot portal: on Research the primary action 'research-start' renders inside #header-action-slot (top context row); on Strategy Center both 'strategy-search-btn' and 'strategy-add-btn' render in that same slot; on Workspace 'workspace-stop-ananta' renders in the slot — and the OLD secondary rows (data-testid=research-header / workspace-header / strategy-center-header) are all gone. (2) The header actions still open their flows: Start Research opens the wizard, Strategy Search opens strategy-search-screen, Strategy '+ Add' opens the add-menu (Import/Manual/AI options). (3) CRITICAL FIX verified — pre-seeded localStorage['ananta_pdfs'] with an OWNER-PROTECTED lab-run entry (/api/lab/runs/demo-bt-run/pdf) + ananta_owner_token + sessionStorage tour_seen; clicking ws-pdf-open triggers an authenticated fetch (Authorization: Bearer …) — network shows 200 status and the 'Download complete' toast fires. NO 'Owner authentication required' text appears. Direct curl confirms /api/lab/runs/demo-bt-run/pdf is 403 without token and 200 (4200 byte %PDF-1…) with token. Note: on the small (~4 KB) lab PDF the download finishes so fast the ws-pdf-progress bar disappears before Playwright can snapshot it — for larger PDFs the progress element IS present in the DOM (Workspace.jsx L260-266 renders it whenever prog[id]!==undefined). Also verified: Trade tab trade-download-pdf registers a 'Trade Report' entry, which appears as a ws-pdf-row and downloads cleanly with the same auth-progress path. (4) No duplicate Stop Ananta: page-wide query returns exactly ONE [data-testid=workspace-stop-ananta] and ZERO [data-testid=emergency-kill-btn] across the whole app (including inside Workspace › Engine & Risk which used to host the emergency kill). Toggling Stop Ananta from the header still hits /api/settings with manual_kill_switch. (5) QuadrantCard CTA moved to title row: DOM inspection confirms the 'Open Engine' and 'Open Risk Monitor' chips are direct children of the card's header flex-row (inHeaderRow=true) — same flex row as the title 'Entry & Exit Engine' / 'Risk Monitor'. Clicking the card still opens the respective modal (role=dialog). No new bugs. The design smell from iter48 (floating 'Ask Ananta' pill overlaps bottom-nav edge at 1440w) remains unchanged and is not in scope for this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: pdfRegistry.downloadPdf (L36) sends Authorization header only when TOKEN_KEY is set — good. It correctly distinguishes 401/403 ('Owner login required to download this PDF') from other failures. Small nit: for very small PDFs the progress UI vanishes almost instantly (setTimeout 2500ms clears it after 100%). Consider keeping the 'Done' state visible slightly longer or animating a brief success pulse so users see completion feedback for tiny files. Not a bug.

HeaderActionPortal (L11) polls with rAF until #header-action-slot exists — safe because AppShell always renders the slot; still, when the slot briefly unmounts on route change the portal children flicker for one frame. Acceptable.

QuadrantCard.jsx (L36) puts the CTA chip inside a <button> that itself has onOpen — the chip is not a nested button, just a styled <span>, so clicks still bubble to the parent button. This is what makes 'the card is still clickable' behaviour work while also putting the CTA next to the title. Correct.
